issue.title: Stop wiping auth credentials on sync 401; use reauth-required
issue.body:
## Summary

Any sync `AuthError` (HTTP 401) permanently deletes the user's SecureStore token via `handleSyncAuthFailure` and forces logout through `emitAuthSessionExpired` → `App.tsx`. Missing credentials are treated the same as revocation. Transient server/DB errors and Better Auth refresh races can also surface as indistinguishable 401s.

For an offline-first app, sync failure / offline / a single bad 401 must **not** log the user out or destroy local drafts.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** 401 during sync → `clearCredentials` → forced login screen; local session destroyed.

**Expected:** Confirmed 401 sets a per-user **reauth-required** flag, keeps SecureStore token and SQLite data, and prompts for password (soft lock). Credentials are deleted only on explicit user sign-out or successful re-login that replaces the token. Network timeouts / offline errors never set reauth.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Replace credential deletion in `handleSyncAuthFailure` with KV reauth flag (e.g. `{userId}:reauth_required`)
- Soft event (e.g. `emitAuthReauthRequired`) that does **not** call `signOut()` / clear token by default
- Missing-creds path: log + skip / set reauth for active user — do not wipe
- Minimal UI shell for blocking re-auth (Settings/Home)
- Update `sync.auth.test.ts` expectations that currently assert `clearCredentials` + forced expiry

**Out of scope**
- Durable login persistence (#291 — land first or in parallel carefully)
- Per-request token plumbing (#294)
- fluent-api structured error codes (optional later)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Sync 401 for active user does **not** delete SecureStore credentials
- [ ] Sync 401 sets reauth-required and surfaces soft re-auth UX; local drafts/SQLite remain
- [ ] Offline / timeout / non-auth `ApiError` never triggers reauth or logout
- [ ] Explicit Settings sign-out still clears credentials as today
- [ ] Unit tests updated; no forced `emitAuthSessionExpired` logout on sync 401

## Verification / test plan

1. Unit: mock 401 in sync → credentials remain; reauth flag set
2. Unit: timeout/network error → no reauth flag
3. Device QA: trigger sync 401 while online → stay on app with reauth prompt; drafts intact
4. Device QA: airplane mode + sync attempt → no login bounce

## File pointers & approach

1. `src/services/sync.ts` — `handleSyncAuthFailure`, missing-cred branches in `syncAllUsers` / `syncAllData`
2. `src/services/syncEvents.ts`, `App.tsx` (~54–59)
3. `src/services/storage.ts` — flag helpers
4. Soft reauth UI entry (Settings/Home)
5. `src/services/sync.auth.test.ts`

## Related series (suggested order)

1. **#291** — Persist auth credentials at login (**P0**)
2. **#292** — Soft reauth / no wipe on 401 (**P0**) — this ticket
3. **#294** — Per-request auth tokens (**P1**)
4. **#293** — Multi-account session safety (**P1**)

## Links

- Project board: [Fluent Mobile Board](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9) — please set Status **Backlog**, Priority **P0** (agent lacked project write permission)

## API readiness note (board audit)

**Status on fluent-api `main`:** Not required — client policy change on sync 401 (keep credentials; reauth-required). Optional later: structured API error codes (not on `main` today as a dedicated contract).

**Implement with:** Local auth/session handling only. No mock API.

### Follow up with fluent-api team
When you pick this up, please ask the fluent-api team:
1. Is the needed feature planned / in progress?
2. Expected ETA (or “not scheduled”)?
3. Is there already an open fluent-api GitHub issue or PR? If yes, link it here; if no, ask them to file one (or file it yourself and link it).

Checked against local fluent-api `main` @ `3ef4025` (2026-07-31).
